turns.user: Design me a strong, printable mortar.
turns.text:
I’ll use the mortar design model and published printable mixes. I need a strength target and ingredient limits to define the search.
What minimum compressive strength and test age do you want, what ingredients may I use, and what are the print geometry (nozzle size, target height, layer height, and cycle time)? If you have no ingredient or geometry limits, say “use defaults.”
